assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, PE150, Hisat2 -> featureCounts; Novogene)
sample_inclusion: HFD-fed male WT (KLF10 flox/flox control) and KLF10 adipocyte-specific knockout (KLF10^AKO) mice, sedentary (no exercise); n = 4 per group
primary_estimand: Effect of adipocyte KLF10 knockout on the iWAT transcriptome of HFD-fed sedentary male mice (genetic estimand, not an exercise effect)
planned_contrasts: KLF10AKO vs WT in HFD-fed mice without exercise (Fig. 5a legend; paper: 2907 up, 1639 down = 4546 DEGs)
exercise_contrast_in_rnaseq: none: exercise (treadmill Ex vs Sed) appears only in physiology, RT-qPCR and western blot experiments (Fig. 4, Fig. 5d-g), not in the sequenced samples
paper_method: edgeR, Benjamini-Hochberg (S4.18.p1); Fig. 5 legend says two-sided Wald tests plus BH
